description: This file defines the Protection class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling sheet protection settings such as locking specific cells, objects, and other sheet elements, as well as managing passwords and encryption algorithms.

classes.name: Protection
classes.description: Represents and manages the protection settings for a worksheet in PhpSpreadsheet, including locking options, protection passwords, and encryption algorithms.

methods.name: isProtectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether any protection feature or password is set, indicating if the sheet is protected.

methods.name: getSheet
methods.description: Retrieves whether the sheet itself is protected.

methods.name: setSheet
methods.description: Sets whether the sheet should be protected.

methods.name: getObjects
methods.description: Retrieves whether objects on the sheet are locked.

methods.name: setObjects
methods.description: Sets whether objects on the sheet are locked.

methods.name: getScenarios
methods.description: Retrieves whether scenarios are locked.

methods.name: setScenarios
methods.description: Sets whether scenarios are locked.

methods.name: getFormatCells
methods.description: Gets the setting for locking cell formatting.

methods.name: setFormatCells
methods.description: Sets the locking of cell formatting.

methods.name: getFormatColumns
methods.description: Gets the setting for locking column formatting.

methods.name: setFormatColumns
methods.description: Sets the locking of column formatting.

methods.name: getFormatRows
methods.description: Gets the setting for locking row formatting.

methods.name: setFormatRows
methods.description: Sets the locking of row formatting.

methods.name: getInsertColumns
methods.description: Retrieves whether inserting columns is locked.

methods.name: setInsertColumns
methods.description: Sets whether inserting columns is locked.

methods.name: getInsertRows
methods.description: Retrieves whether inserting rows is locked.

methods.name: setInsertRows
methods.description: Sets whether inserting rows is locked.

methods.name: getInsertHyperlinks
methods.description: Retrieves whether inserting hyperlinks is locked.

methods.name: setInsertHyperlinks
methods.description: Sets whether inserting hyperlinks is locked.

methods.name: getDeleteColumns
methods.description: Retrieves whether deleting columns is locked.

methods.name: setDeleteColumns
methods.description: Sets whether deleting columns is locked.

methods.name: getDeleteRows
methods.description: Retrieves whether deleting rows is locked.

methods.name: setDeleteRows
methods.description: Sets whether deleting rows is locked.

methods.name: getSelectLockedCells
methods.description: Retrieves whether selection of locked cells is locked.

methods.name: setSelectLockedCells
methods.description: Sets whether selection of locked cells is locked.

methods.name: getSort
methods.description: Retrieves whether sorting is locked.

methods.name: setSort
methods.description: Sets whether sorting is locked.

methods.name: getAutoFilter
methods.description: Retrieves whether auto-filtering is locked.

methods.name: setAutoFilter
methods.description: Sets whether auto-filtering is locked.

methods.name: getPivotTables
methods.description: Retrieves whether pivot tables are locked.

methods.name: setPivotTables
methods.description: Sets whether pivot tables are locked.

methods.name: getSelectUnlockedCells
methods.description: Retrieves whether selection of unlocked cells is locked.

methods.name: setSelectUnlockedCells
methods.description: Sets whether selection of unlocked cells is locked.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the hashed password used for protection.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for protection, hashing it unless already hashed.

methods.name: setHashValue
methods.description: Sets the password as an already hashed value.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the name of the hashing algorithm used.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the hashing algorithm used for encrypting the password.

methods.name: getSalt
methods.description: Retrieves the salt used in hashing.

methods.name: setSalt
methods.description: Sets the salt value.

methods.name: setSaltValue
methods.description: Sets a specific salt value.

methods.name: getSpinCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of hashing iterations.

methods.name: setSpinCount
methods.description: Sets the number of hashing iterations.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies if a given password matches the hashed protection password.
